Approve the exact versioned 30-category by A/B/C role policy or attach independently reviewed N/A reasons.
Name the approved local dataset root and category allowlist; separately name Mint, PCB, or other protected categories only if authorized.
Authorize physical JSON file-byte access and explicitly acknowledge that train and test sections may share one file.
List exact train and test fields; decide separately whether train normal/OK status and the OK/NG/defect tokens embedded in official_sample_key may be read.
Authorize official image identity metadata and provide the independent reviewer/source trust root.
Supply independently reviewed role identity manifests, pairwise A/B/C disjointness evidence, and a separately reviewed C identity certificate.
Choose G1-FULL-A, G1-PROTOCOL-MATCHED, or both as separate evidence regimes; do not merge either into C0 memory.
Decide separately whether future DINO feature extraction is allowed and name the checkpoint/source identities.
Set the exact output directory, maximum output bytes, and fields permitted for disclosure.
Keep test outcome labels and masks separately denied unless a later, separately scoped authorization explicitly grants them.
